# Toast

A short confirmation of what you just did, with its log position and, where it can be reversed, Undo.

`Workbus.Toast` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<Workbus.Toast>…</Workbus.Toast>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Workbus.Toast">…</x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |

| `children` * | `ReactNode` |  |
| `tone` | `'success' \| 'danger'` |  |
| `cursor` | `string` | The log position the action produced, e.g. "#1288". |
| `action` | `{ label: string; kbd?: string; onClick?: () => void }` |  |
